Exhibits, Financial Statement Schedules, and Reports on Form 8-K

provenance: T9 tranche 2 (INTERIM SARBANES-OXLEY NUMBERING stratum — the transitional era the eval set jumped over between textron-2001 and bac-2006). sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000104746903008257/a2104280z10-k.htm, accession 0001047469-03-008257, filed 2003-03-11, FY ending 2002-12-28, 863,995 bytes, legacy HTML. AUTHORED FROM THE DOCUMENT, NOT FROM PIPELINE OUTPUT, and verified 2026-08-17 by an independent tag-strip scan importing nothing from src/: cover reads 'For the fiscal year ended December 28, 2002'; body headings are 'ITEM 14. CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES' (2x: contents row + body) and 'ITEM 15. EXHIBITS, FINANCIAL STATEMENT SCHEDULES AND REPORTS ON FORM 8-K' (2x); zero occurrences of 'Item 9A' or 'Item 9B'. THE STRATUM: SEC Release 33-8124 (effective 2002-08-29) inserted 'Controls and Procedures' as Item 14 and pushed Exhibits to Item 15; Release 33-8238 (effective 2003-08-14) then moved Controls to Item 9A and made Item 14 'Principal Accountant Fees and Services'. Filings whose period ends between those dates carry a THIRD numbering regime that segment.ADDED/ALIAS_FROM did not model — this is the same regime gs-2002 exposed as burned held-out debt, now confirmed on a second real, unmutated filing from a different sector and filing agent. EXPECTED RED AT AUTHORING TIME (watched before any fix, hard rule 2): item 15 is absent from the envelope entirely (ADDED['15'] = 2003-08-14 keeps it out of `expected`, so find_candidates never makes it a candidate and its 13,787-char exhibit section is annexed to item 14), and item 14 carries the era-wrong label 'Exhibits, Financial Statement Schedules, and Reports on Form 8-K' / Part IV over Controls-and-Procedures text. Item 12 is asserted `incorporated_by_reference` on the authority of the document: all three of its sentences are pointers (one to the 2003 Proxy Statement, two to Items 7 and 8 of this same Form 10-K) and none carries inline substantive content. STATUSES VERIFIED IN-DOCUMENT: items 10/11/12/13 open 'The information appearing ... of the 2003 Proxy Statement is incorporated by reference'; item 5 is an INTERNAL pointer ('may be found in "Financial Information by Quarter (Unaudited)" in Item 8 on page 78 of this Form 10-K') and stays `extracted` per ADR-004; items 4 ('None.') and 9 ('Not applicable.') are trivial bodies, `extracted` per ADR-005 rule 1. The item-14 anchor 'Quarterly Evaluation of the Company's Disclosure Controls' occurs once in the raw fixture. Added 2026-08-22 (gates-2026-08-22 T5-2 / SD-1, ADR-027): item 5's heading scores title_similarity 0.841 — the LOWEST similarity at or above the 0.8 strict cut in the corpus (measured 2026-08-22), so its existing 0.95 pin plus this method pin hold the upper edge of STRICT_SIM's empty band (0.727, 0.841].
